note: Single source of truth for the NS-3 deployment-provenance pins (DR-001/NS-2,
PR #82): the SHA-256 digests of the two program ELFs whose bytes were
recorded from a deploy_devnet.sh-flow build of the approved tree, plus the
toolchain pins that produce byte-identical bytes.
Consumed by BOTH scripts/devnet/deploy_devnet.sh and the CI
'Verify ELF deployment provenance' step via scripts/devnet/ns3_check_provenance.mjs.
If a legitimate source/dependency/toolchain change shifts the ELF bytes, the
deployment gate STAYS CLOSED until the new build has been independently
reviewed and the new digests deliberately re-pinned here in a reviewed PR.
Never update a digest merely to make a build green.
2026-11-16 re-pin (PR #111, deliberate + reviewed, per docs/DEVNET.md §1):
the Phase 0 reconciliation pass in the same PR edits comments/docs only — no
codegen change — but comment lines move source line numbers and the SBF
ELFs embed line/panic-location metadata, so the rebuilt bytes differ from
the 2026-11-12 deployment build. Two independent pinned-toolchain rebuilds
agree byte-for-byte — CI run 43907738016 and a local deploy_devnet.sh
--build-only run, both on the hash-verified platform-tools v1.54 archive —
and both pass the SBPF v0 architecture gate and the structural NS-3
identity gate; only the digest pins moved (scanner
e24ddc5ea3fbfe13f5732166a6a3c68d91fdc6de98b4046e05d35f4483cd6c98 ->
6fd86675f7976840ed4be4d57ea1bf446dec21bcd17bfad79e8af57f2076199c).
The bytes actually deployed on-chain on 2026-11-12 remain the pre-re-pin
build until the owner deliberately redeploys; no deployment was executed
as part of this re-pin.
